g.title: odoo_hrms_erd
g.text: Cleardeals Odoo HRMS — Entity Relationship Diagram
PostgreSQL 17 · database odoo_hrms_db · Odoo 19 · employee master, document vault, document templates and recruitment · 20 tables · 616 columns · IE (Crow’s Foot) notation
Generated from the live production schema · PK = primary key, FK = foreign key, U = unique, N = nullable

g.title: hr_employee
g.text: employee master · 63 of its columns come from hr_employee_cleardeals

g.title: hr_version
g.text: contract / job version history · Odoo 19 replaces hr.contract with this

g.title: hr_job
g.text: job position · shared by employee master and recruitment

g.title: hr_employee_family
g.text: dependant / family member records · EMPTY IN PRODUCTION

g.title: hr_employee_document
g.text: document vault record · one row per issued document, with expiry

g.title: hr_applicant
g.text: job application · the busiest table in scope

g.title: document_template
g.text: HTML template with {{variable}} placeholders · renders to PDF

g.title: document_template_variable
g.text: typed placeholder definition · one row per {{variable}}

g.title: hr_applicant_refuse_reason
g.text: rejection reason · drives the refusal mail that custom_recruitment_fix patches

g.title: res_company
g.text: company · multi-company boundary (2 rows) · 5 of 131 columns shown

g.title: res_users
g.text: login user · create_uid / write_uid on every table · 5 of 26 columns shown

g.title: res_partner
g.text: contact record · backs employees, companies and applicants · 6 of 73 columns shown

g.title: ir_attachment
g.text: binary store · files behind vault documents and generated PDFs · 7 of 22 columns shown

g.title: legend
g.text: • Column tint marks the module that declared the field. Untinted columns are stock Odoo 19.
• hr.employee carries 63 columns declared by hr_employee_cleardeals — Indian statutory identifiers, banking detail, issued assets and the onboarding document slots exposed by the HR API.
• Odoo 19 has no hr_contract table. Contract and salary data live on hr_version, which versions a single employee over time.
